title: Threat modeling
description: For a change to data flows, trust boundaries or authentication: a diagram, the threats it raises and a decision for each one.

rules.instruction: Draw or update the data flow diagram of the components the change affects, with their trust boundaries.
rules.verification: Link the diagram from the change and check that it shows the new flows and trust boundaries.

rules.instruction: For each new flow or boundary, list what can go wrong using a method the security owner approves, such as STRIDE.
rules.verification: Check that the threat list gives, for each new flow, a threat or the reason none applies.

rules.instruction: Record for each threat its mitigation, the risk acceptance by the security owner or a follow-up issue.
rules.verification: Check that each threat links to code or a test, a recorded acceptance or an issue.
